llm.answer:
**Core Graphics – Apple Developer Documentation (PDF)** *Key points from the three uploaded pages* | Topic | Main Take‑aways | Source | |-------|-----------------|--------| | **What Core Graphics is** | • A lightweight, low‑level 2‑D rendering engine built on Quartz.
• Delivers high‑fidelity output with unmatched fidelity.
• Handles path‑based drawing, transformations, color management, off‑screen rendering, patterns, gradients, shading, image data, image creation, masking, and PDF creation/handling.
• On macOS it also exposes services for display hardware, low‑level user‑input events, and the windowing system. | [1], [2] | | **Primary data types** | • `CGFloat` – basic floating‑point scalar.
• `CGPoint`, `CGSize`, `CGRect` – geometric primitives.
• `CGVector`, `CGAffineTransform` – vector and transform utilities. | [1], [2] | | **Core classes & structures** | • `CGContext` – the drawing environment.
• `CGImage`, `CGImageMask` – bitmap images and masks.
• `CGPath` / `CGMutablePath` – immutable/mutable paths.
• `CGLayer` – off‑screen reusable content.
• `CGColor`, `CGColorSpace`, `CGColorConversionInfo` – color handling.
• `CGFont` – glyphs and layout for text.
• `CGGradient`, `CGShading` – radial/axial gradients and custom shading.
• `CGPattern` – 2‑D patterns.
• `CGPDFDocument`, `CGPDFMarkedContentItem`, `CGPDFStructureElement` – PDF support.
• `CGDataConsumer`, `CGDataProvider` – abstracted I/O for raw buffers.
• `CGFunction` – callback‑based custom functions. | [1], [2] | | **Quartz services** | • **Quartz Display Services** – direct access to macOS window server for configuring display hardware.
• **Quartz Event Services** – manage event taps (filters) for observing/altering low‑level user‑input streams.
• **Quartz Window Services** – information about windows managed by the macOS window server. | [1], [2] | | **Enumerations & constants** | • A wide range of enums (e.g., `CGBitmapLayout`, `CGComponent`, `CGContentInfo`) and constants that describe bitmap layouts, color models, component types, and content tone mapping. | [3] | | **Documentation & guidance** | • The PDF references the **Quartz 2‑D Programming Guide** and other related docs for deeper learning. | [3] | ### Summary Core Graphics is a foundational 2‑D rendering framework that powers many Apple graphics APIs. It offers a rich set of primitives (points, sizes, rectangles, vectors, transforms), drawing contexts, image and color handling, and PDF support. The framework also exposes low‑level services for display configuration, event handling, and window management on macOS. Enumerations and constants provide fine‑grained control over bitmap layouts, color spaces, and shading. For developers, the documentation links to the Quartz 2‑D Programming Guide and related resources for detailed usage.
